Date:                       2026-09-16

Original source:            ddfc6a5
Compact source:             ddfc6a5 + uncommitted compact inline node layout
Build:                      Release, Apple Clang 17.0.0.17000604, arm64, -O3 -DNDEBUG
Hardware:                   Apple M2, macOS
Command per binary:         phys_broadphase_compare 10
Protocol:                   Three sequential/interleaved executions per version
Summary:                    Median of three per-execution mean maintenance-plus-query times
Tree lifetime:              Persistent across ten queries in each case; first includes construction
Layouts:                    Static and moving/resizing uniform, clustered, mixed-floor, and wide-size bounds
Validation:                 Each executable checks all backends against SAP; this report compares their tree rows
Notes:                      Fixture motion and reference generation are outside timing for all versions.
                            Node-pair visits, leaf checks, output counts, and reinsertion counts must match exactly.
                            These are standalone query costs, not full mixed-shape simulation timings.

Execution order: original-1, compact-1, compact-2, original-2, original-3, compact-3
Pair counts, node-pair visits, leaf checks, heights, and proxy maintenance counts match exactly.
